basics.name: Ruijie Xu
basics.label: PhD Student
basics.summary: Ph.D. student advised by Prof. Xin Tan in the DMCV Lab at East China Normal University and research intern at Shanghai AI Laboratory. Research focuses on data generation for embodied AI, including controllable 3D scenes, simulation-based multimodal data, and safety-oriented benchmarks.

work.name: Shanghai AI Laboratory
work.position: Research Intern, Safe and Trustworthy AI Center
work.summary: Research on embodied data generation, spatial question-answer synthesis, and safety-oriented evaluation of vision-language models.

projects.name: MUSE
projects.description: Memory-grounded multi-agent authoring of controllable 3D scenes, with AuthorBench for evaluating requirement satisfaction and preservation.

projects.name: JointEdit3D
projects.description: Reference-guided 3D scene editing with SceneEdit3D-15K paired data and SceneEdit3D-Bench for evaluation.

projects.name: Exemplar2VQA
projects.description: Scalable spatial question-answer generation in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026.

projects.name: TSHA
projects.description: Multimodal question-answer benchmarks for indoor safety hazard assessment with vision-language models.

projects.name: awesome-ai2-thor
projects.description: Curated resources for AI2-THOR and embodied AI research.
